```yaml
name: Pre-Commit Bot

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  validate-permissions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pre-commit

      - name: Validate permissions
        run: |
          if [[ $GITHUB_EVENT_COMMENT_BODY == *'@github-actions run precommit'* ]]; then
            echo "Validating permissions..."
            if [[ $GITHUB_ACTOR == $GITHUB_EVENT_ISSUE_USER_LOGIN ]] || [[ $(gh repo collaborators --json login | jq -r '.[]' | grep -q "^$GITHUB_ACTOR$" && echo "true" || echo "false") == "true" ]]; then
              echo "::set-output name=permissions_valid::true"
            else
              echo "::set-output name=permissions_valid::false"
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            echo "Comment does not match trigger phrase."
            exit 1
          fi

  execute-precommit:
    needs: validate-permissions
    if: needs.validate-permissions.outputs.permissions_valid == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pre-commit

      - name: Run pre-commit
        run: |
          pre-commit run --all-files --autoupdate

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'Pre-Commit Bot'
          git config --global user.email 'pre-commit-bot@example.com'
          git add .
          git commit -m "Auto-formatting and linting by pre-commit bot"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.6.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}
```
